cohort: 830 infants with 1 or more known risk factors for neonatal hypoglycemia admitted to the mother-baby unit of a single tertiary-care center from May 2017 to April 2018
finding: Currently accepted risk factors for neonatal hypoglycemia are limited in their ability to identify infants who subsequently develop hypoglycemia, and most infants who develop hypoglycemia achieve normoglycemia with feeding-based interventions.
